findings.description: The two unchanged "crystallized only after user sign-off" bullets are creation-scoped rather than a complete account of all mutations to existing records, so a reader need not infer that no accepted record can change; their delegation reinforces this but is not needed to rescue them. Each added passage is its document's needed account of the no-prompt date advancement, not redundant. A useful third sweep would target immutability and mutation vocabulary, e.g. `(records?|frontmatter|metadata|fields?) .*\b(unchanged|immutable|frozen|static|set once)\b|\b(diffs?|changes?|updates?|sync)\b.*\b(records?|memory|metadata|fields?)\b`, to catch complete-sounding claims about records staying fixed or fields only being set at creation without using the current sweep's terms.
